summary: All listed acceptance criteria have explicit evidence in the work report, policy evidence, deterministic checks, and patch. The patch implements acceptance-first drafting, freezes and digests the ClaimGraph before RequirementDraft, rejects falsey-present ClaimGraph divergence, validates PlanDraft claimRefs against frozen claims, and includes targeted tests plus the required full check run.

criteria.evidence: Patch changes src/ahra/alignment_session.py to run ACCEPTANCE_DRAFT_OUTPUT before REQUIREMENT_DRAFT_OUTPUT, pass only boundaryContract/boundaryContractDigest to AcceptanceDraft, store frozenClaimGraph/frozenClaimGraphDigest in the snapshot, pass frozenClaimGraph/readOnlyInputs to RequirementDraft, reject RequirementDraft claimGraph/claim_graph divergence including present falsey values, and reject unresolved PlanDraft claimRefs. tests/test_alignment_session.py adds tests for acceptance-first freeze, boundary criterionRefs, falsey-present claimGraph divergence, and unresolved plan claimRefs. Deterministic evidence shows uv run python -B scripts/check.py exited 0 with these tests passing.
